tracks.title: Sorrow'sDeep
tracks.interpretation: Watching water without needing to escape: reflective stillness and gradual clarity.

source.about: This song gradually builds toward beautiful harmonies and clear melodic lines.
source.scene: A quiet moment beside flowing water, watching the ripples and reflections move across the surface.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.title: The Bongos
tracks.interpretation: The mind moves from diffuse thoughts into clearer ideas, gently rather than through crisis.

source.about: This track develops gradually, with one melody flowing seamlessly into the next from beginning to end.
source.scene: A quiet moment of reflection, as the mind moves from ambient, dreamlike thoughts toward clearer ideas, with gentle spaces of stillness in between
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.title: Aurel
tracks.interpretation: A trapped voice escapes danger; fear becomes exhilaration and freedom.

source.about: Aurel is its own world. It begins with a voice that feels trapped, moves into a beat, and opens into virtuosic piano. Given time, it carries the listener from one place to another.
source.scene: A character struggles through water before escaping a chaotic situation. Gradually, the fear gives way to exhilaration, and the act of running away becomes unexpectedly joyful.

tracks.title: Nebuú
tracks.interpretation: Uncertainty and isolation gradually give way to love, familiarity and belonging.

source.about: Nebuú was originally titled “The Story of King Nebuú.” The track tells the life story of a fictional character who lives in my imagination. I later reshaped the ending into a more pop influenced experience, giving listeners a familiar and relatable way back from his world.
source.scene: Trembling waves symbolize the uncertainty of life before gradually transforming into a warmer, more familiar world. A person emerges from isolation and learns to connect with others through love.

tracks.title: Crystal
tracks.interpretation: A luminous, detached perspective: observing life from above, rather than pursuing a goal.

source.about: Crystal is a song about living in the clouds and looking down at the world. It expresses the superego, an observing perspective that sees life from above. The song is meant to capture the feeling of stepping outside yourself and viewing everything from a distance.
source.scene: A figure sits quietly among luminous clouds, looking out across a dreamlike sky washed in pink, violet, and gold. Suspended above the world, the figure observes from a distance, surrounded by softness, light, and peaceful introspection. A geometric window floats in the distance, suggesting another world or perspective.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.title: Green Tea
tracks.interpretation: A costly choice about what to protect under pressure; survival and responsibility.

source.about: Green Tea is a fight for survival. It begins with heaviness, settles into calm in the middle, and reaches a powerful resolution that feels less like an ending and more like a continuation. This is a story that rewards patient listening and allows its narrative to unfold over time.
source.scene: A woman finds herself trapped in a game where every choice carries a cost. Surrounded by temptation, greed, and uncertainty, she must decide what she is willing to protect and what she might sacrifice to survive. As the world around her becomes increasingly chaotic, survival begins to feel like a game.

tracks.title: Aurelillo
tracks.interpretation: Weightless relaxation closes one chapter while gently opening another.

source.about: Aurelillo is meant to be a deeply relaxing trance piece that serves as the album’s outro. After the chaos of Green Tea, it brings the listener into a place of calm, closing this album while gently leading into the next.
source.scene: The sensation of floating weightlessly through a soft, open space as a gentle tingling spreads through the body. Colors and light slowly shift, signaling completion and carrying the moment from one chapter into the next.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.title: que Soñaba en el piano
tracks.interpretation: Criticism from someone close unsettles confidence; reflection has not yet resolved the doubt.

source.about: I wrote this song while sitting at the piano after receiving unexpected criticism from someone close to me about a musical collaboration. I was trying to process the response and the doubt it created. Was my judgment that far off? Could I no longer distinguish between something good and something sloppy? Was I becoming sloppy myself? The experience deeply unsettled me, and the song emerged from that confusion.
source.scene: A quiet room after a difficult conversation. The piano remains still while the same words replay in the mind, creating a pause filled with questions. Nothing outwardly changes, but the familiar space feels different as confidence quietly gives way to uncertainty.

tracks.title: David Jones Snow
tracks.interpretation: Defending an authentic creative voice through resistance, vulnerability and scars.

source.about: You want a tense song? David Jones Snow is your song. It answers the doubts raised by the previous track. Forget all of that. This is my world, and I create the sounds I want. I am willing to be vulnerable and share their chaos because they express something real to me. It is the feeling of saying, “Oh yes. No one is stopping me. Here we go again.”
source.scene: A boat pushes forward through towering waves, carried by a melody that refuses to stop. The wind and water scrape against the skin, leaving scars from the journey, yet the boat continues through the storm regardless.

tracks.title: Dream 2
tracks.interpretation: The scene conveys exhaustion, continuing pain and blurred waking/dreaming; the playful production is secondary.

source.about: This song builds on the foundation of another song that is dear to me, using its powerful synths to create something energetic and fun. My sister felt inspired by the music and sent me a set of English lyrics. I selected the lines that fit the song, edited them, and incorporated some of them into the final version. I sing them with a strong accent, since Spanish is my first language, and I embrace that playfulness throughout the track. At one point, I even say, “I don’t even know what I said, for real.”
source.scene: A woman sits motionless in the center of a room while everything around her continues to move. She feels defeated, and even as she travels from place to place, the same pain follows and weighs on her. Life begins to feel like sleepwalking through a dream until she can no longer tell whether she is awake, asleep, or simply going through the motions. Exhausted, she wants only to return to sleep and dream again.

tracks.title: Tortilla Song
tracks.interpretation: Pressure leaves marks that become part of an authentic, individual form. Tension and playfulness coexist with a clear creative direction. Heat is a secondary metaphorical connection, not the track’s literal subject.

source.about: Tortilla Song is a funny song to me. It is tense and loud, yet it makes a quiet statement. It may seem like I do not know what I am doing, but I actually have a clear direction. It is playful, energetic, and filled with the sound of trumpets.
source.scene: A form holds the marks left by pressure. Those traces gradually become part of its character, revealing something authentic and individual. The scene carries tension and playfulness together: an apparent imperfection can belong to a clear creative direction.

tracks.title: Cowgirl
tracks.interpretation: Floating and laughing while trusting others to carry you safely through the night.

source.about: Cowgirl Song is my interpretation of a phrase that has stayed in my head for a long time. I combined it with the idea of the heroes of the night and the catchy, repeated Ahooah!
source.scene: A lightheaded moment of floating freely, laughing, and saying nonsense while still believing that heroes will come to carry you safely through the night
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective

tracks.title: Wait for me UNO
tracks.interpretation: A playful repeated pursuit of the beat, rather than a frightening repetition.

source.about: In music, counting is very important, especially finding your way back to the first beat so everything stays consistent. I sometimes struggle with that, so this song represents my constant chase of the one. That is why it is called “Wait for Me, Uno.” I am calling out, “Wait for me! Uno, wait!” The song turns that musical chase into its own story.
source.scene: Numbers move in a repeating circle while the number one keeps slipping just out of reach. Each time the rhythm seems ready to settle, the pattern shifts and the chase begins again. The scene feels playful rather than desperate, like trying to catch the first beat before the music moves forward without you.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Peaceful

tracks.title: Dar
tracks.interpretation: Fear, humility and hope accompany accepting a responsibility, inspired by Mary's Annunciation.

source.about: Dar is a song I created around the B major and B minor scales. Moving between them creates captivating melodic lines and a sense of emotional tension. The song represents giving yourself fully to a mission.
source.scene: The scene captures the Annunciation at the moment the Angel Gabriel reveals the Virgin Mary’s mission. Fear comes first, followed by humility, wonder, and a growing sense of hope. She feels overwhelmed that she has been chosen, yet she recognizes her strength and accepts what lies ahead. Her emotions move through the uncertainty of “Yes. Yes! Yes? Wait... I said yes, YES.” holding emotions at the same time.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.title: romA
tracks.interpretation: Love opens into everyday life: piano, birds, a window and the world continuing outside.

source.about: romA is written backward, which is why the capital letter appears at the end. When reversed, it becomes Amor, the Spanish word for love. The track captures a moment created with love, with birds chirping live, life unfolding in the background, and my piano flowing alongside it. I love you.
source.scene: A room with large windows overlooking trees and palm trees, with birds flying across a blue Nevada sky filled with cinematic clouds. A piano sits near the window while cars pass below, a bus stops, and everyday life continues. The scene feels open and alive, as though the song itself is breathing with the world outside.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.title: OOO2
tracks.interpretation: A nocturnal sinking ship, panic and bodily struggle against drowning; no peaceful shore is promised.

source.about: I spent an entire day writing OOO2, completely dedicated to it. There was no food and no distractions, only the song and its flow. Inspired by the sinking boat scene in Life of Pi, the track feels both tense and weightless. You move through it as if struggling against a persistent droning current.
source.scene: A ship moves through the night toward an unfamiliar destination. Inside a small cabin, anticipation is mixed with unease. Then the vessel begins to sink. Panic spreads through the corridors as alarms and Morse code distress signals cut through the darkness. Everything tilts, shifts, and falls. The deep blue ocean becomes now this black liquid before your eyes, demanding your body, your blood, and your soul as the struggle against drowning takes over.

tracks.title: Anoche
tracks.interpretation: Remaining faithful and focused amid distractions; then bringing daily life back to the piano.

source.about: Anoche is a reinterpretation of “Que Soñaba en el Piano” from the album SDLC_02. It combines different genres, styles, and harmonies, all moving toward one goal: making the song fun to listen to.
source.scene: A vast, quiet room filled with soft light. A woman kneels in the center, facing the Tabernacle, while another version of herself speaks to her and tries to pull her away. She remains still and focused. The scene then shifts into ordinary daily life, where she sits at her piano as news, conversations, and human experiences continue to reach her. She takes everything in and tries to understand it, firmly repeating, “No, no,” because nothing will separate her from Him.

tracks.title: The Rebellion
tracks.interpretation: Anger at injustice inside an inescapable system: opposed forces remain in conflict.

source.about: The Rebellion moves through two competing flows, with the piano and drums constantly colliding to create a restless, confrontational sound. It carries anger toward the injustices found in human relationships and everyday life. It is the feeling of being unable to leave while becoming increasingly frustrated with staying.
source.scene: Two opposing currents move through the same confined space, one fluid and deliberate, the other sharp and relentless. They collide again and again, but neither can escape or overpower the other. The space fills with tension as every impact reflects the frustration of being forced to remain inside a system

tracks.title: John 3:16
tracks.interpretation: A quiet space for God's self-giving love, prayer and reflection; care and generosity are the emotional bridge.

source.about: I attended Mass, where John 3:16 was part of the Gospel reading. I felt inspired to create a melody that could accompany the passage, giving the listener space to read, pray, and reflect.
source.scene: "For God so loved the world that he gave his only Son". John 3:16
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful, Faith

tracks.title: Sandais
tracks.interpretation: An exploratory piano pulse in anticipation suddenly releases color and movement.

source.about: This was an unexpected recording. I simply started playing, and the piece evolved while I was lucky enough to be recording. It became a beautiful transitional song filled with unexpected changes. It feels playful, constant, intriguing, and completely centered on the piano.
source.scene: A quiet space suspended in anticipation, filled with the feeling that something is about to happen. A steady pulse moves beneath the silence, creating tension that continues to build. Suddenly, the space opens into a rush of color, movement, and emotion, releasing everything that had been waiting underneath.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Tense, Warm

tracks.title: Lo que vibra en la vida
tracks.interpretation: Starting over in a foreign land through honorable sacrifice for one's family.

source.about: I created this song using a scale of Neapolitan Dorian (Spanish origin) to honor the stories of my grandfather and great grandfather. It reflects their struggles and the honorable choices they made, which helped make the life I live today possible.
source.scene: At dawn, a shipwrecked man reaches the shore of an unfamiliar land. Exhausted and carrying almost nothing, he looks back at the ocean and understands that everything he once knew has been left behind. He gathers the courage to walk toward a new life. As the unfamiliar town begins to wake, he finds work and accepts every sacrifice placed before him. His labor allows his siblings to study and build futures of their own. While they open books and enter classrooms, he continues working quietly, finding dignity and purpose in giving them the opportunities he had to leave behind.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Tense, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.title: I hate to love you
tracks.interpretation: Accepting uncomfortable criticism to learn and continue a creative practice one loves.

source.about: This track explores a relationship of love and hate with something you feel compelled to do. You love the process, even though the task leaves scars. You know the struggle is necessary because it will help you grow, so you continue. In the end, you hate how much you love it.
source.scene: A small classroom with only a musician and a teacher. The musician presents work that has never been shared this openly before. The teacher listens closely and offers a direct critique. The moment feels vulnerable and uncomfortable, but it is also necessary. The choice becomes clear. Accept the discomfort, learn from it, and continue moving forward without stopping.

tracks.title: Don Perro
tracks.interpretation: Shared laughter, rebellious play and an unapologetically personal voice.

source.about: My teacher challenged me to create a song with a more “solid beat”. For some reason, my brain interpreted that as, “Do they want me to make something predictable, like reggaeton? Ugh.” So I did. I created a reggaeton song in my own style. It is Susi’s one and only reggaeton song, built around a single lyric: “What are you gonna do, Mr. Dog?” Irreverent and playful.
source.scene: A lively Spanish bar filled with small wooden tables, shared plates, cold drinks, bright lights, and overlapping conversations. Friends move between tables, laughing loudly and saying whatever comes to mind. The scene feels familiar yet rebellious, as if everyone belongs while refusing to behave like everyone else. It is playful, unapologetic, and completely comfortable with its own absurdity.
source.mood: Cinematic, Playful, energetic, irreverent, humorous, bold, rhythmic.

tracks.title: Disdain
tracks.interpretation: Examining envy and unfairness, then rejecting the resentment and returning to one's own path.

source.about: Disdain is about an ugly feeling that surfaced one day when I experienced genuine envy toward someone. I examined the emotion and realized how much it felt like poison spreading through my heart and entire body. I wrote the song from the perspective of rejecting that feeling, addressing it directly and declaring that I never want to experience it again.
source.scene: An employee has spent years arriving early, staying late, and becoming highly capable at the work. A new person joins the company and immediately receives the same salary without having the same experience or abilities. Resentment begins to grow as the employee watches the unfairness unfold. Then comes the realization that envy is causing more harm than the situation itself. Disgusted by the feeling, the employee chooses to release it and return attention to their own path before the bitterness takes control.

tracks.title: Te Quiero
tracks.interpretation: Rebuilding oneself in a dark cave; discovering piano as expression, survival and a way toward hope.

source.about: Te Quiero is a song I wrote after being ill for some time in a foreign country. It is about moving through a tunnel and finally seeing a distant light. Even the smallest glimpse brings hope, along with the realization that the only way to reach it is by learning true self love.
source.scene: A winged figure sits inside a dark cave, her wings three times the size of her body. Mud covers the feathers, hiding their natural pearl white color. Deep within the cave, she discovers an old grand piano. She does not know what it is or how to use it, but she sits down and gently places one finger on a key. A sweet sound fills the cave and immediately captures her. She begins pressing more keys, discovering endless combinations of notes capable of expressing every part of her life. The melodies are not created so she will be remembered. They are necessary for her survival. Everything she has carried inside can finally leave her through the music. The sounds feel as though they must be released and shared rather than kept within her.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.title: ...25 (Bonus Track)
tracks.interpretation: The warm memory of a shared Catholic Christmas carol: family, community and belonging on a cold night.

source.about: This is a traditional Catholic Christmas carol from Spain, I believe. My husband Francisco and I were in DrummerLab’s practice studio. As he played, I began singing the carol and suddenly decided to record it and add harmonies. I consider it a bonus track because it preserves the feeling of a rehearsal. At the end, I intentionally left in a conversation about editing the song and its pitch. I chose not to clean it up because that unpolished moment became part of the song’s character.
source.scene: A group of family and friends gathers on a quiet street in Spain on a cold Christmas night. They are wrapped in winter coats, scarves, hats, and gloves as their breath becomes visible in the air. Warm streetlights illuminate the buildings and stone pavement while the group sings together, filling the night with voices, laughter, and the repeated sound of “fum, fum, fum.” Neighbors listen from nearby windows and doorways as the familiar carol brings warmth and community into the winter street.

tracks.title: Linden Ocean
tracks.interpretation: An unsettled sea moves through mounting tension and a disturbance to relief on firm ground.

source.about: It starts with a sense of tension, but keeps moving forward before easing into restful piano chords. Then it shifts abruptly to a deep synth that really comes through on headphones; on other speakers, it can sound too heavy. Finally, it settles into a calm, dry sound that feels like relief.
source.scene: A calm sea at first. The water gradually gathers force, as if something is approaching. A sudden disturbance breaks the surface, leaving the sea restless and uncertain. Then the water recedes. Dry land, finally.

tracks.title: Logic
tracks.interpretation: Repetition slowly makes a familiar place strange; subtle unease grows without a sudden crisis.

source.about: Logic is a trance track built around a repeating pattern. Melodies layer over it, sometimes transforming the underlying beat. The changes unfold gradually, without abrupt shifts.
source.scene: An ordinary town at dusk. Streetlights hum, windows glow, and the wind moves through the trees. The same view returns throughout the scene, but each time, the light, shadows, and distant movement have shifted slightly. Nothing announces the change. The repetition becomes hypnotic, then quietly unsettling, as the familiar town begins to feel wrong.

tracks.title: El Tuki Tuki
tracks.interpretation: Remembering an ordinary shared day: games, conversation, friends and small joyful moments.

source.about: It’s a collection of melodies that simply work together, mixed with background sounds that add texture and weave in the experience that inspired the song.
source.scene: It's 4th of July, you are with the group of friends playing games in a very nice place. Then alot of different scenes happen where they were walking in the parking lot. Talking in the lobby, grilling and eating, and at the end, at the pool wathichng the fireworks

tracks.title: Magical Project
tracks.interpretation: Patient attention to a peaceful woodland leads to wonder; the source scene reveals Our Lady of Champion.

source.about: It has a calm, unhurried flow that rewards patient listening, then takes an unexpected turn at the end.
source.scene: A quiet forest in early autumn. The camera moves slowly along a trail, lingering on light through the leaves and the gentle movement of the trees. Nothing seems unusual at first. As the music continues, a soft light between two trees becomes more noticeable. At the final turn, the camera returns to that spot and reveals a radiant figure in white. The late reveal draws on the account of Our Lady of Champion’s appearance in the woods.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.title: songon B
tracks.interpretation: Discovery expands into wonder, responsibility and the effort of growing into a hero.

source.about: This track feels like someone telling you a story. The music follows a character’s journey through discovery, the weight of responsibility, and the gradual growth into a hero. It has the scale and wonder of an adventure.
source.scene:
Subdued piano keys accompany an arrival at a ballroom: leaving a coat, taking a drink, exchanging pleasantries. Then the doors open to the main room, and its scale and architecture inspire awe. A hymn rises, and everyone begins to hum along.
The moment bursts apart. Crystals fly through the air and fall into a space where metal rods bounce up from the floor. Finally, the scene settles in a New York park. A bicycle is hard to get moving, so the rider shifts their weight forward with each push of the pedals.

tracks.title: Project 0
tracks.interpretation: Holding steady one day at a time: continuing to try despite difficult circumstances and uncertainty.

source.about: A Day at a Time is another possible title for this track. It’s about living with uncertainty and still choosing to move forward. A tense, grounding bass holds the music steady while a light melody roams above it.
source.scene: A student struggles to pass his courses while facing difficult circumstances in his life. He keeps pushing, choosing to continue and try one more time. He stays focused on the present while holding on to hope for the future.

tracks.title: Oración A Jesús
tracks.interpretation: The effort of quieting a distracted mind opens into prayer and contemplation in God.

source.about: Esta cancion es sobre la oracion. como es que cuando comenzamos a rezr pasamos por este ciclo de distracciones, adaptacion hasta que realmente logramos alcanzar esa paz y estado de meditacion en Dios.
source.scene: A person sits down to pray. As she remains still, her thoughts come to life around her, showing how difficult it is to quiet her mind and enter a contemplative state.

tracks.title: Elbe
tracks.interpretation: A steady, safe place: gentle water, warm fire and home stay secure throughout.

source.about: Elbe is about reaching stability. It feels comfortable and steady throughout, with no sudden turns or surprises.
source.scene: A house overlooking the ocean. At dusk, a fire burns on the sand while the waves roll in gently. Warm light glows from the house behind it. The scene lingers there, calm and secure, with everything feeling just right.

tracks.title: Lala
tracks.interpretation: An outro-like culmination still floating: transition, weightless suspension and sleeplessness. Missing someone, grief and nostalgic memory are not primary signals.

source.about: A brief, outro-like passage that gathers the feeling of everything that came before it. Lala marks a culmination while remaining weightless and in motion, a closing moment that still seems to float, carrying the listener gently into what follows.
source.scene: A vast, weightless space surrounded by a purple gradient that shifts from deep violet to lavender. A few indistinct forms float slowly through it, hinting at what came before. Their movement gradually slows until everything seems suspended in one moment. It feels like a culmination, followed by the quiet release of letting it end.

tracks.title: Seda
tracks.interpretation: A graceful piano farewell framed by trees and golden sunlight: completion, warmth and quiet appreciation.

source.about: This track feels like an encore, the song an artist plays when the audience applauds for one more. It’s a graceful piano piece that gives the album its final, golden bow.
source.scene: A pianist plays a piano among tall trees, facing the sunlight filtering through their leaves. As the final notes ring out, the camera rises from the keys to the view on the album cover: branches framing a bright sun against the sky. The shot holds there as the music fades, giving the album a peaceful ending.
source.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
